fields.label: Show floating badge
fields.name: enabled
fields.instructions: Turn the lower-right floating badge on or off across the whole site.

fields.label: Badge image
fields.name: image
fields.instructions: Shown floating in the lower-right corner on every page. PNG with transparency works best.

fields.label: Badge link
fields.name: link
fields.instructions: Where the badge goes when clicked, e.g. /story/new-brand-look or a full https:// address. Leave blank to show the badge without a link.
